news.title: Former contractor banned from all Fulton County Schools, accused of theft
news.summary: Police arrested Jason Johnson at Cambridge High School after investigating thefts across multiple Fulton County campuses.

news.title: Deputy tries to pull over driver who didn’t have headlights on. Then a chase started
news.summary: The Paulding County Sheriff’s Office released dash camera and body camera video from the July 12th chase on Buchanan Highway. They identified the driver as Todd Montgomery.

news.title: Person shot, businesses’ windows shot out in midtown Atlanta
news.summary: A person has been shot in the 800 block of Peachtree St. NE in Midtown Atlanta, according to police.

news.title: Man facing criminal charges after chucking a drink at Dairy Queen drive-thru worker in Cobb County
news.summary: "It’s okay to ask for a manager. It’s okay to request your order be fixed. It’s never okay to assault someone who is simply doing their job," police said.

news.title: Rockdale deputies searching for missing 14-year-old girl
news.summary: The Rockdale County Sheriff's Office is asking for the public's help in locating a 14-year-old girl who has been reported missing and is believed to have run away.

news.title: Atlanta police recover stolen car with 2-year-old child inside
news.summary: Atlanta police have recovered a stolen vehicle and found a child safe following a reported kidnapping along Spring Street.

news.title: Midtown Atlanta shooting leaves 1 injured
news.summary: A shooting in Midtown Atlanta closed a section of Peachtree Street late Thursday night near Seventh Street NE.

news.title: Shooting investigation underway in Midtown Atlanta, police say
Tucker man gets second life sentence after pub shooting conviction
news.summary: A 28-year-old man was sentenced to life in prison after he was convicted of shooting and killing a man outside a Tucker pub in 2023, according to the DeKalb County District Attorney's Office.

news.title: Wanted person rammed patrol cars before chase and capture, police say
news.summary: Atlanta police took a wanted person into custody Thursday afternoon following a vehicle pursuit and foot chase.

news.title: Video shows wild crash following chase that ended in residential Atlanta neighborhood
news.summary: Police said officers attempted to box in the suspect's gray sedan, but he allegedly rammed two patrol vehicles before fleeing.
